title: Books and reading stories vs visual art stories on points
question: Does a story about books and reading get more points than a story about visual art?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about books and reading gets more points than a story about visual art.
expect: If true, points per story for books and reading stories should be at least 1.5x the value for visual art stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, books and reading against visual art

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h348 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h348 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
